development_screen: Verified primary full-coverage Jan-Apr ledger: all months nonnegative, arithmetic mean at least10%, at least10completed actual trades. Diagnostic routes cannot rescue a failed primary. This screen does not replace original case acceptance.
acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.
capital: Original settled-cash rule, allocation0/1 only; at most one ETF, no leverage, same-day reentry forbidden, T+1 and available dividend cash handled normally. V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

Attached centrounded+5%TP,fixed6%stop,stopfirstsamebar,actualadversegapfill. Max14inclusivecalendar days,lastofficialclose on/before entry+13. No v30preclose exits. Halfday clocks>=close absent. V4 arbitrarytime interface retained/unqualified.

Totalfitweight Ndates, notNrows, so extra clocks do notsilently weaken Ridge penalty. Every clock/ETF fromsame date moves together in bootstrap; datawithinaday are dependent.
source: Reuse immutable independently verified v35 raw and as-issued calibrated forecasts, input/financial panels and fixed trade labels. Check all top-level, daily and training SHAs against committed v35 delivery manifest. Underlying base models remain daily-retrained on data available before that day; using cached issued forecasts does not freeze the economic model to one old month. No raw source downloads or uploads.
case_workflow: A failed independently verified primary blocks beforecreating any caseoutput. If primary passes, extend v35 raw/as-issued forecasts using the unchanged v35 daily financial/price recipe throughSeptember, preserve all preMay records, then apply the frozen v37 meta rules to continuousMaySeptember. Source extension engineering is not implemented by the development runner; it must be completed and verified if authorized. No case fitting or primaryswitch.
hypothesis: V36 reduced all-candidate MSE without avoiding actual March losses. Learn the return sign of the ETF ranked first in as-issued v35 calibrated scores. Loss-magnitude weighting targets gain/loss balance; test industry and financial state beyond issued score diagnostics. V13 tried old premarket-only top raw mean-return calibration; this is a distinct top calibrated classifier on v35 financial forecasts, not a claim that top calibration was never tried.
selection: When source v35 full estimate is ready, choose larger as-issued calibrated point, tie SOXL. Fixed before labels. Label selected net log return C+sign*D. Include all ready top choices, even negative scores and source-rejected candidates; actual capital occupancy is not a training condition. Query filter acts only on source-eligible choices unless standalone diagnostic. Unselected ETF results never become outcomes of this choice.
history: Daily 00ET, original whole-date chronological paired-terminal prefix (all 3/4 clocks and both ETFs) before cutoff, stop first unknown or unmatured. Among prefix latest 120 dates with as-issued full calibration ready at all clocks. Min 60 dates. Time weights 63-date half-life normalize N dates, split across actual clocks. Current/future records cannot train. Source fallback until 60 mature dates, preserving the v36 rule without warmup tuning.

features.top_lower: source calibrated top score minus original common risk radius
features.raw_direction_agreement: sign*(original raw L-original raw S), sign +1 for L and -1 for S
features.aligned_relative5: sign*existing relative_5, volatility-normalized SOXX-vs-QQQ 5-day relative return
features.aligned_breadth5: sign*existing breadth_5, already 2*8-issuer positive fraction-1; not centered twice
features.aligned_volume_diffusion: sign*existing volume_direction_diffusion at current completed clock

fit: Weighted standardization uses original date-split weights. y=1(selected net log return>0), magnitude weights=w*abs(return), normalized to N dates. Objective sum(m*(logaddexp(0,eta)-y*eta))+5||beta||^2, free intercept, equivalent L2 LogisticRegression C=.1. Damped Newton,100 iterations, max gradient<1e-8, Armijo backtrack1e-4 with additive1e-13 arithmetic tolerance; failures raise. Single class or zero magnitude uses constant gain share (all zero=>.5), not certainty. Uniform return scaling does not change normalized fitting weights.
meaning: Not win probability: ideal q(x)=E[positivepart(net log return)|x]/E[abs(net log return)|x]. q>.5 iff expected net log return positive at an unrestricted population optimum. A regularized finite-history estimate is not a guarantee. 60% wins at+.04 and40% losses at-.08 gives gain share .24/.56<.5. Threshold .5 follows zero expected log return, not month-return tuning. This alone does not optimize turnover or a monthly floor.
decision: PRIMARY keeps source full_band choice only if quality>.5+1e-12; original source risk band retained, no reranking or second-place replacement. Missing source/features or expired prefix=>cash. Before 60 mature meta dates preserve source action for every risk route. Separate band diagnostic uses quality-max(0,higher90% upward bootstrap deviation)>.5. Standalone uses quality>.5 without source band after warmup; same original ranking. Diagnostics cannot rescue failed primary.
uncertainty: 199 circular10-date blocks, seed826+ET date ordinal; all clocks and selected ETFs from same date repeat together. Refit normalization, standardization, each head per draw. Source as-issued scores and current base model held fixed. Conditional meta-model sensitivity, not complete prediction coverage or nonnegative-month guarantee. Only context_band uses lower quality; primary uses point risk estimate alongside existing source band.

routes.context_gate: PRIMARY contextual loss-weighted Logit AND source band
routes.frequency_gate: intercept-only gain share AND source band
routes.context_band: context lower quality AND source band
routes.standalone: context quality without source band after warmup
routes.double_cost: primary frozen actions, own double-cost labels

Full run independent feature equations and explicit repeated-date fit equations, qualities/actions,8 capital books,104 summary assertions. Verified source hashes and4 exact v35 control CSVs. No new raw data.
